children: UMH Properties secured a $10.2 million interest-only Fannie Mae mortgage at a fixed 6.03% rate for a 10-year term.
Closed Aug 28, 2026 Fannie Mae mortgage via Wells Fargo for ~ $10.2M on a 267-site community.
Loan is interest-only, fixed at 6.03% with a 10-year term, providing near-term cash flow flexibility.
Earlier payoff of a $2.8M mortgage generated $7.4M additional proceeds now reflected in financing.
Proceeds earmarked for acquisitions, expansions, rental homes and short-term repayment of higher-rate debt.
Community occupancy rose from 69% at acquisition (2014) to 95% after renovations and rental home program.
